name: Soil Moisture Sensor
fullName: Capacitive / Resistive Soil Moisture Detection Sensor Module
tagline: Measures volumetric water content and soil hydration levels for smart irrigation
description: Soil moisture sensors measure the dielectric permittivity or electrical resistance between two probes inserted into soil. Capacitive models prevent electrode corrosion and provide stable analog voltage readings corresponding to dry, optimal, or waterlogged soil conditions.

pinout.name: Analog Out
pinout.desc: Analog voltage reading corresponding to soil moisture

wiringNote: Calibrate in air (100% dry) and in water (100% wet) to map raw ADC readings to percentage values.
commonMistakes: Submerging the top electronic circuitry header into water (only the probe blades should enter soil)
Using resistive sensors continuously powered without duty-cycling (causes rapid electrolysis corrosion)
